messages:
Mira (Product): uploaded mock for Audit Log export UI. Quick pass please — mainly copy + a11y + security nits.
Sam (Design): looks tidy. nit: label 'Presets' is confusing. recommend 'Saved views'.
Matt (Eng): heads-up: CSV header order is `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. Changing visible labels breaks parsers. We can add a small `export_manifest.json` instead.
Elaine (Security): request: any export that includes KMS IDs/aliases must show a clear warning: "Export contains key metadata. Ensure export destination meets your compliance controls." Also log an audit event on opt-in.
Aria (A11y): SR checklist: filter chips need `role=button` + `aria-pressed`; saved-views popup must support arrow nav; announce "Export started" + progress with `aria-live=polite`.
Sam (Design): visual nit: the tiny KMS lock badge tooltip fails contrast. propose adding text label or high-contrast variant.
Matt (Eng): implementation plan: emit manifest with `export_version`, `headers`, `header_aliases`. Add an opt-in checkbox "Include key metadata" default OFF. For enterprise, require typed confirmation: `I understand this export contains key metadata`.
Elaine (Security): +1. Typed confirm must be enforced and we should surface the export destination guidance.
Aria (A11y): modal needs focus trap, initial focus on typed input, `aria-describedby` linking to the security blurb, and SR-friendly validation errors.
Mira (Product): ok owners: Matt (backend), Sam (copy & visuals), Aria (a11y), Elaine (security). I'll draft PR checklist.
